description: SereneDB test-config for duckdb_iceberg's catalog_test_config_setup tests, run against apache/iceberg-rest-fixture through the extension's own test/configs/fixture.json. Every entry is a known reason the test cannot run here -- see tests/duckdb/README.md.

skip_tests.reason: Expects upstream DuckDB main's COPY file packing (one output file for three ~1.5 KiB inputs with target_file_size_bytes=2000); the vendored core follows the v2.0 release line, which writes one file per input here. Revisit on the next DuckDB update.
SereneDB's spatial build has no PROJ (duckdb_spatial 7b79dd71, Boost.Geometry backend), so EPSG coordinate systems such as GEOMETRY('EPSG:4326') are not defined.
